core_obligations: Form the three extended alternating Cech complexes F-bullet, F'-bullet (for the g_j) and F''-bullet (for the common refinement); the projections to the first two represent the identity on i_*R H_Z(F).
Reduce to exhibiting sigma in H^c((F'')-bullet(X)) mapping to c_f(s) and to det(a_ji) c_g(s).

Write the explicit cocycles: sigma_{1..c} = s/(f_1...f_c), sigma'_{1..c} = det(a_ji) s/(g_1...g_c), and the mixed terms with coefficients lambda = the wedge coefficient of e_1 wedge ... wedge e_c in the displayed wedge expression.

Verify the cocycle condition: the required alternating-sum identity is the image of xi = e_{i_0} wedge ... wedge (a_{j_01} e_1 + ... ) wedge ... under the Koszul differential in the (c+1)-st exterior power of the free module on e_1,...,e_c, hence zero.
Conclude c_f = det(a_ji) c_g as maps on H^c of the local cohomology complex.
proof_roadmap: Three-complex setup with identity maps; reduction to one cocycle sigma; explicit determinant cocycles; Koszul-differential vanishing; conclusion.
difficulty_reason: An explicit-cocycle construction across three Cech complexes whose determinant transition is verified by a wedge/Koszul differential computation; the cocycle exhibit and the vanishing identity are the substance.
